free_text_notes.physician_note: 82-year-old man with osteoporosis, hypertension, admitted 6/18 with acute exacerbation of COPD. Ambulated 100 m with PT yesterday without desaturation. 6/25 12:45: Desaturating to 84% with ambulation this morning, below baseline; needs re-evaluation before discharge.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Slept well overnight. Voiding without difficulty. A routine delirium screening was performed each morning as per standard protocol. The patient scored zero on every assessment and showed no signs of confusion. The patient experienced a brief episode of anxiety approximately one year ago. They recovered fully, are not currently on any treatment for it, and no anxiety was observed during this stay.
